name: Asset-harvesting contract 0x19a2 unauthorised payer transferFrom
summary: The shared asset-harvesting contract 0x19a23ddaa47396335894229e0439d3d187d89ec9, which MEV bots on BSC hold live BUSDT allowances to, exposes two permissionless entry points. Selector 0xac3994ec records an order under a caller-supplied key and debits only msg.sender, so anyone can designate themselves as that order's privileged executor. Selector 0x1270d364 then reads the payer, recipient, token and amount out of calldata and performs token.transferFrom(payer, recipient, amount) after checking only that msg.sender matches the address stored with the order; nothing binds the payer to the order or requires the payer's consent. An attacker contract deployed 63 seconds earlier registered its own order and used it to move the entire BUSDT balance of bot 0x8c2d4ed92badb9b65f278efb8b440f4bc995ffe7, which had an unlimited allowance outstanding.
notes: Non-upgradeable contract deployed by a top-level creation transaction. Its 3,426-byte runtime hashes to 0x24baa5b548ec939273217de9618ac83fd5b8f78f2115068bf1d7c456638cfb16 at both the creation block 22711195 and block 33435892, the address holds no code at block 22711194, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero, so the deployment is the only pre-exploit code change.

The component is the single unauthorised transferFrom in the exploit receipt, log index 5: 366,058.040206325661577467 BUSDT moved from bot 0x8c2d4ed92badb9b65f278efb8b440f4bc995ffe7 to attacker contract 0x3918e0d26b41134c006e8d2d7e3206a53b006108, which was the bot's whole BUSDT balance. The equal-sized 366,058.040206325661577467 BUSDT taken from the WBNB/BUSDT pair 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae in the same transaction was a flash swap and was repaid as 367,159.518762613502083719 BUSDT; that 1,101.478556287840506252 BUSDT financing fee does not reduce gross victim depletion, so the attacker's realised 364,956.561650037821071215 BUSDT is lower than the loss recorded here. No other address was drained in this transaction and the attacker EOA sent no further exploit transactions. BUSDT is valued at par; DefiLlama returns no historical quote for this token at the incident timestamp.

The loss-bearing party is MEV bot 0x8c2d4ed92badb9b65f278efb8b440f4bc995ffe7, which is retained as the protocol identity for continuity with the seed row. The defect and therefore the code-age target is the shared asset-harvesting contract 0x19a23ddaa47396335894229e0439d3d187d89ec9 that the bot had approved.
